    "final": "**No\u2014faster native eviction should remain a secondary optimization.** Existing evidence establishes faster eviction calls, but no end-to-end serving benefit.\n\n[The retained eviction findings](/home/philip/.local/share/vllm-semantic-cache-ext-next/efficacy/20261110/trials/findings-before-1/checkout/FINDINGS.md:40) report:\n\n- Exact-state replay accelerated large eviction calls roughly **5\u20137\u00d7**, occasionally **23\u00d7**.\n- Native eviction consumed **less than 0.05% of workflow time** in the primary/tight workloads.\n- A larger document batch reduced eviction time from **159 ms to 18 ms**, but eviction represented only **0.09% of workflow time**, and live outputs differed.\n\nUnder a fixed-work accounting assumption, completely eliminating eviction would therefore save under approximately **0.05\u20130.09%** of measured workflow time.
